programs.description: Program packages, each resolved from the project and exporting stacks(request)

production.description: Asks each program for the stacks of a released version

stack.description: Name of the one stack to apply, absent applies every stack in dependency order

destroy.description: Destroys the stacks and removes them

title: Deploy
description: Applies the stacks a program package states for a project through the Pulumi Automation API, group after group in dependency order, refreshing live state first
